summary: Fortis Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching its Q1 2026 investor presentation materials used in its earnings conference call. This is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is described. The filing is merely an earnings-related disclosure.
